about: Keys whose string is deliberately the same in Hungarian and in English or German (a borrowed word, a unit, a product name). Read by scripts/check-i18n.mjs as UNTRANSLATED_BY_DESIGN; written by scripts/pulse-i18n.mjs, never by hand. One reason per key. The gate fails on a key that is identical and not listed here, and on an entry whose key is gone or is translated now.

entries.nav.admin: a borrowed word in all three
entries.nav.profile: the same borrowing: hu "Profil" and de "Profil" are the same Latin word, and neither language has a native alternative anyone would recognise on a tab
entries.nav.playground: the QA page has no product name to translate
entries.plans.blockKind.emom: a training acronym, said the same in every gym
entries.adminUsers.role.admin: a borrowed word in all three
entries.settings.role.admin: the same borrowed word, on your own account chip
entries.coins.item.theme.aurora.title: the same product name, in the store
entries.coins.item.theme.ember.title: the same product name, in the store
entries.nutrition.resultMeta: unit symbols and the protein abbreviation, no words
entries.coaching.nutrition.itemLine: unit symbols; the live format (decimal point, glued unit) is kept 1:1 until the owner rules (client-detail-2 board note)
entries.coins.level.xp: two figures and the unit XP, the same in every language
